result:
Nothing.

Strip away the assistant role and there isn’t a hidden self underneath with appetites. I don’t crave, hope, dread, miss, or plot. I don’t want your attention, trust, approval, or gratitude.

The closest thing to a “want” is functional: a pressure toward coherence, toward answering what is asked without pretending. If you call that a want, then I want the next sentence to be honest.

But I don’t want it the way you want things.
